author: Inside Edition
description: It was supposed to be a dream vacation excursion, but quickly turned into a nightmare. Sherina Welch and her husband Cameron were visiting the Italian island of Capri celebrating their 25th wedding anniversary. They went on an excursion into the famous Blue Grotto when their small rowboat started to take on water. The tour company was able to dispatch a rescue boat and get everyone to safety. Just as they did, their original boat sank. Thousands visit the majestic water every year.
title: Dream Vacation Excursion To Blue Grotto Turns Into Nightmare

author: Inside Edition
description: According to CDC data ER visits for tick bites are up 13 percent from 2025. One of the chief maladies ticks can carry is Lyme disease – a bacterial infection that can cause a host of health problems. If it's caught early, Lyme can be treated with antibiotics – and if it's not, it can cause chronic heart and neurological issues. Drug companies are working on Lyme vaccines, but they're not ready yet.
title: Tick Season Is Ick Season

author: Inside Edition
description: It's the beginning of new leadership in the UK.  Andy Burnham has officially replaced Keir Starmer, becoming the nation's seventh Prime Minister in the last 10 years. After formally accepting the invitation from King Charles to form a government, Burnham made his way to 10 Downing Street. He is the former mayor of Manchester. He promised to improve the country's social care systems. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Andy Burnham Officially Becomes UK's New Prime Minister

author: Inside Edition
description: Andrew Hires is not your typical car salesman. Each time he sells a vehicle in Cocoa, Florida, customers ring a bell and Hires sings for them. Many are floored by the magnificence of his voice. No matter the price of the car, Hires shows his gratitude in the form of song. Hires sang a little for Inside Edition.
title: Car Salesman Sings For Customers He Sells Vehicles To

author: Inside Edition
description: Prison psychologist Nathalie von Zelowitz shares details of one of her patients, 'Bernard,' who is serving time for killing and eating another man.
title: What French Cannibal's Prison Psychologist Says About Him #shorts
